b: I remember that, many years ago, using margarine wasn't a choice; it was a necessity because real butter was expensive and not always available.
These days, aside from AOP butters like Le Beurre Bordier or Beurre d’Isigny, butter is comparable in price to margarine. Still, many recipes are formulated with margarine.
I understand that some cakes benefit from using vegetable oil, and that butter isn't universally better. But in those cases, we can simply use vegetable oil instead of margarine.
